name: SYNDA R1
summary:
SYNDA R1 is an industrial wheeled humanoid developed by STEP (新时达), which Haier identifies as part of its robotics business following its 2025 acquisition. The model was announced in December 2025 for work in industrial environments.

Haier describes inspection, material handling and quality-checking as intended tasks. The robot extends the group’s embodied-robot portfolio beyond domestic assistance into factory applications. It is distinct from the HIVA household robot, and this record does not transfer home-robot specifications to the industrial model.
